source: Nexvyn OS public SDK 1.16 / Native SDK 1.2 / ABI v1 (OS 1.4.0), plus announced preview features

statusLevels.released: in the active SDK snapshot Studio builds against (public release or an owner-approved pre-release of the next OS); usable in production ports
statusLevels.private-preview: in Nexvyn OS development, not in a public release yet; never used on a production path

evidenceLevels.emulator: Ryujinx console profile; relative only, never console speed
evidenceLevels.host: built or unit-tested on the PC only

ownerReleased.note: Owner decision: Vulkan is always on and counts as released in Studio from OS 1.4.0 (graphics.vulkan.minOs). Older OS builds have no Vulkan: assess and doctor point them to the GL path. Code checks NXN_CAP_VULKAN at start and keeps the GL fallback. platform_refresh.py applies this list after deriving statuses.

cpu.value: AArch64 Cortex-A57 about 1 GHz, 4 cores: core 0 runs the shell (input loop, system audio mixer), core 3 is reserved for the system; the host grants an app up to two worker cores from 1 and 2

ram.value: 4 GiB shared with the OS; no per-app guarantee; malloc returns NULL at the shell reserve (native.memoryReserveMB, default 64)

process.value: one process, one window, one GL context; no fork/exec/system/popen; no memory isolation from the OS

loader.value: AArch64 .nxvmod; imports only from the fixed host table (nxn_*, newlib, pthreads, a small libnx subset); check with nxv_native check-win

package.value: .nxvapp up to 20000 files and 1 GiB unpacked; no game data, BIOS or firmware; signing optional

toolchain.value: devkitA64 r29-3, gcc 15.2, C11/C++17, -march=armv8-a+crc+crypto; C++ exceptions, RTTI and thread_local need minNative 1.1

gl.note: OpenGL 4.3 core or GLES 3.2 through nxn_display_proc or SDL2 windowed. No compat profile, no shared contexts, all GL on the display thread. Turn ARB_buffer_storage off; glMapBufferRange reads and transform feedback are unreliable on this driver.

nexgfx.note: ngfx_* scene renderer for baked .nxsc/.nxtx scenes (BC1/BC3/BC5 textures) inside your GL context.

vulkan.note: Vulkan through NVK (apps target the 1.3 baseline; see apiVersions), on by default for native apps and SDL2 windows when the driver check at start passes; the hidden setting native.vulkanOff=1 turns it off. Check NXN_CAP_VULKAN (nxn_caps_has_gfx_api) and fall back to GL. Console: the canary passed windowed (960x540) and fullscreen (1280x720), 1200 frames each, p50 16.6-16.7 ms (60 fps), and the GPU load test passed on the OS 1.4.0 candidate. Vulkan Model on the console: 10 copies, 36,300 triangles, 60 fps (owner run 2026-11-25); vkQuake played several minutes on the console without a crash, with Vulkan Model at 50-58 fps beside it. Pipeline caches persist between launches. WSI: one window, RGBA8 UNORM, FIFO, 2-3 images, CPU-copy present. GL-heavy apps share the GPU channel with the desktop. Emulator: Ryujinx runs NVK compute wrongly, so Vulkan windows look empty there; judge Vulkan only on a console. Needs OS 1.4.0 or later: OS 1.3.x has no Vulkan, so ports targeting it use the GL path. nxn_vk.h ships with SDK 1.16.

apiVersions.driverReports: Vulkan 1.4 (NVK, Mesa 26.2.4, on GM20B; seen in the emulator probe and on the console)
apiVersions.hostBaseline: Vulkan 1.3 (the OS dispatch layer and the canary target 1.3)
apiVersions.source: Nexvyn OS 1.4.0 development documentation and console runs

textures.value: BC1/BC3/BC5 on the NexGFX path; KTX ETC2/EAC for g3d; ASTC only when probed

present.value: frames go through the shell compositor; frame handoff 0.10-0.22 ms measured on console; the OS paces the window, swap interval 0 is fine

notOffered: direct present to the console window (planned study only)

C++.note: C++17 (C++20/23 on the clang profile: nxv_native clang-build); libstdc++ linked into the module

Lua.note: Lua 5.4.7 app runtime; embedded Lua in a C port builds as ordinary C

Python.note: CPython 3.12 is one of the four primary app runtimes ("python3"). Only embedding Python inside a native port needs your own AArch64 build of CPython.

JavaScript.note: QuickJS-ng app runtime or the web/WASM runtime; no Node.js or V8

TypeScript.note: compile to JavaScript for the QuickJS or web runtime

Java.note: miniJVM app runtime only; no HotSpot, no JIT, no Swing/LWJGL

Kotlin.note: no JVM or Kotlin/Native target for this platform

C#.note: no Mono/CoreCLR/IL2CPP runtime (Unity, MonoGame, FNA need one)

Go.note: no Go runtime or target for this loader

Rust.note: needs a no_std or custom aarch64 target linked as a C static library; not verified in the kit

Zig.note: can emit AArch64 C-ABI objects; not verified in the kit

Objective-C.note: gcc can compile it, but Cocoa/Foundation are absent

Pascal.note: no Free Pascal target in the kit; translate or build FPC for aarch64-none

Assembly.note: x86 assembly must be rewritten or replaced by the C fallback

GDScript.note: Godot has no Nexvyn OS export; porting the engine itself is a separate large project

vulkan_rt.title: Ray tracing / mesh shaders
vulkan_rt.note: not offered by the driver or WSI

x11_wayland.title: X11/Wayland windowing
x11_wayland.note: replace with SDL2 windowed or nxn_display

audio_fmod_wwise.title: FMOD/Wwise
audio_fmod_wwise.note: no AArch64 builds for this OS; replace with SDL2 audio, OpenAL Soft or miniaudio

fork_exec.title: Child processes
fork_exec.note: fork/exec/system/popen do not exist; turn helpers into threads or functions

dlopen.title: Dynamic plugins
dlopen.note: no Linux .so; link plugins statically or build them as .nxvlib (2 code-memory objects each, setting native.windowedLibs)

map_fixed.title: Fixed or sparse mappings
map_fixed.note: no fixed addresses, no large PROT_NONE reservations; compat mmap is heap-backed

jit_exec.title: JIT / dynarec
jit_exec.note: nxn_jit_* only, opt-in (native.windowedJit off by default); the kernel has 10 code-memory objects system-wide; console NOT_RUN; start with an interpreter

x86_asm.title: x86 SIMD/assembly
x86_asm.note: needs a portable C or NEON path (sse2neon)

ptr32_assumption.title: 32-bit pointer casts
ptr32_assumption.note: pointers are 64-bit; casts to int/DWORD truncate

drm_online.title: DRM / online services
drm_online.note: Steam, EOS and anti-cheat cannot run; keep checks intact and document

luajit.title: LuaJIT
luajit.note: JIT mode needs nxn_jit; build the interpreter (-DLUAJIT_DISABLE_JIT) or use PUC Lua

mono_clr.title: Embedded .NET/Mono
mono_clr.note: no CLR runtime on this platform

dual-mapped W^X code buffers (setting native.windowedJit, off by default; console NOT_RUN)
recover data aborts on app threads (setting native.windowedFaultHandler; console NOT_RUN)
Vulkan entry points (weak import; older hosts return NULL); check NXN_CAP_VULKAN first
free heap minus shell reserve before big loads (capability bit 42)
ask for up to 2 worker cores, throughput class
declare the working set before a big load
port input helper: two-finger rotate (angle_delta, angle_total)
port input helper: double tap (double_tap_ms 300, double_tap_dist 20 px)

libraries.notes: Kit recipes (sdl2-nexvyn 2.28.5 (nexvyn.2), OpenAL Soft 1.23.1, SQLite 3.47.2 without WAL, GLib without gio ...) plus devkitPro portlibs (see devkitproPortlibs; installable, versions not pinned by the kit). curl/mbedtls are not tested in a window.

notShipped.brotli: not in the SDK kit (no recipe, not in the kit library list); the OS source has its own copy for internal use

versionSources.note: Paths are inside the SDK snapshot (nexvyn_sdk/). devkitPro portlib versions are not pinned by the kit, so none are listed.

devkitproPortlibs.note: Installable from devkitPro; versions come from the installed portlibs, not from the kit. Not tested in a Nexvyn window unless listed in testMode.

deviceValidation.status: Released features have console evidence for the GL path from OS 1.2.2 (frame rates below). N3/N4 features (JIT, fault handler, guard pages, TLS, resize, RAM limits) have no console run yet. Vulkan: canary, GPU load test and windowed/fullscreen passed on the console with the OS 1.4.0 candidate; Vulkan Model reached 60 fps with 36,300 triangles and vkQuake ran several minutes on the console (owner runs 2026-11-25).

0.expectation: Unknown: no graphics path found in source.

1.expectation: 2D/software games: full speed is realistic (mGBA 59.5 fps, Doom at its 35 fps cap on console).
1.start: Native resolution, 60 fps (or the engine cap), dirty-rectangle present.

2.expectation: Old fixed-function GL / early 3D: 60 fps likely once the GL path is shimmed (Quake timedemo 58.9 fps on console).
2.start: 720p handheld, 1080p docked at render scale 0.75, 60 fps cap.

3.expectation: GL 3.x / GLES 3 games of the 2005-2012 class: 30-60 fps depending on draw calls and shaders.
3.start: Handheld 720p at scale 0.75-1.0, docked 1080p at 0.67, 30 fps cap until measured.

4.expectation: Modern GL 4.x / Vulkan / Direct3D 11-class engines: expect 30 fps at 540p-720p after optimisation; heavy titles may not reach it.
4.start: Render scale 0.5-0.67, 30 fps cap, low shadows/post-processing, compressed textures.
4.evidence: documented (third-party ports on this GPU recommend 30 fps, 400p)

5.expectation: Beyond what this GPU/driver is known to do (D3D12-class features): may be tried, may not run. Blocked only where it is proven not to work.
5.start: Try a small prototype first; keep a GL 4.3 path in mind.

rules: Call nxn_should_quit() at least every 250 ms in loading loops and set "loadingHint": true (5 s not-responding limit otherwise).
Vsync off in the port: the OS paces frames; never wait for vsync on the game thread.
Read files in 256 KB-1 MB chunks (setvbuf); never per frame. Small reads made a WAD load take 10 s on console.
Keep GL call streams short: every GL call goes through the GPU-lock trampoline.
Set app.json "memory" to the measured need and check every allocation.
Measure handheld and docked separately in the emulator; emulator numbers are before/after comparisons only.
performance.threadRule: Plan for the main thread plus at most two worker threads of real work: the host grants workers cores 1 and 2 (core 0 runs the shell, core 3 the system). Join every thread before main returns; never hold a lock across I/O.
performance.jitRule: An interpreter path is the safe start (mGBA runs full speed interpreted). JIT counts against 10 code-memory objects system-wide: use 1-2 large buffers.
references: console (OS 1.2.2, GL path): mGBA 59.5 fps, Chocolate Doom 35 fps (cap), Ironwail timedemo 58.9 fps, Tour 3D 58.8 fps

console (OS 1.4.0 candidate, Vulkan, 2026-11-25): canary windowed and fullscreen, 1200 frames each, p50 16.6-16.7 ms; Vulkan Model 10 copies, 36,300 triangles, 60 fps; vkQuake several minutes, no crash
emulator only: Red Alert 2 skirmish in docked and handheld, 54-60 fps in game (emulator numbers)
emulator timings are relative only; Vulkan cannot be judged in the emulator (NVK compute is wrong in Ryujinx)

game.use: new native game: loop, GL quad batch, action map, fullscreen

port.use: upstream CMake project: pinned tag+commit, patches, no fork

sdl2.use: SDL2 upstreams with the windowed sdl2-nexvyn

emu-skeleton.use: CPU core plus JIT-memory skeleton (interpreter first)
emu-skeleton.note: The kit template builds a stand-alone NRO (nexvyn_add_nro, appletMainLoop), not a windowed module. scaffold.py uses the windowed game template plus this skeleton's helper sources (libnx JIT replaced by nxn_jit).

decomp-skeleton.use: C game from decompiled or recompiled source with PC types and compat_fs
decomp-skeleton.note: The kit template builds a stand-alone NRO (nexvyn_add_nro, appletMainLoop), not a windowed module. scaffold.py uses the windowed game template plus this skeleton's helper sources (libnx JIT replaced by nxn_jit).

vulkan.use: Vulkan app with a GL fallback (checks NXN_CAP_VULKAN through nxn_vk_available); needs OS 1.4.0 / SDK 1.16

native.chooseWhen: C/C++ source with a build system; the default for ports

lua.chooseWhen: Lua or LOVE-like script games and small tools

javascript.chooseWhen: JS/TS apps without DOM or Node

web.chooseWhen: HTML5/WebGL2/WASM games and apps; runs only in the OS browser and is not packaged as .nxvapp; WebGL cube 48 fps on console

python3.chooseWhen: Python utilities; one main-thread GIL, up to 4 interpreters; CPython 3.12, default for targetSdk 2.0

python-legacy.chooseWhen: existing PocketPy apps only (runtime "python" with targetSdk < 2.0); new Python work uses python3

c-interpreted.chooseWhen: tiny C tools only (TinyCC, runtime "c"); never ports; on-demand component

java.chooseWhen: Java source without Swing/LWJGL (miniJVM, runtime "java", frozen at SDK 1.8); on-demand component

squirrel.chooseWhen: existing Squirrel 3.2 apps only (runtime "squirrel", frozen at SDK 1.8)

game-engine.chooseWhen: content rebuilt in the OS Game Engine instead of porting code

gepack.note: Game Engine packages (gepack) exist in the OS source but have no SDK documentation; undocumented, not verified

componentModel.note: compatibility runtimes are downloaded on demand by the OS ComponentService; older packages keep working

app.json memory.use: MB the app needs at start; the OS refuses to start when not free

app.json loadingHint.use: not-responding wait 120 s instead of 5 s during long loads (minSdk 1.13)

app.json minNative.use: 1.1 gives own heap, TLS, C++ exceptions, live resize

native.windowedLibs.use: user setting for .nxvlib loading; off by default

native.windowedJit.use: user setting for nxn_jit_*; off by default; console NOT_RUN

native.windowedFaultHandler.use: user setting for nxn_fault_handler_set; off by default; console NOT_RUN

native.memoryReserveMB.use: shell reserve (default 64 MB); malloc returns NULL below it

native.compositorPause.use: shell releases caches in fullscreen; shell setting, not an app API

app.json fullscreenPause.use: true frees the compositor's memory while the app runs fullscreen (OS 1.4.0)

native.vulkanOff.use: hidden numeric setting; 1 turns Vulkan off at start (GL path stays)

perf.overlay.use: OS performance panel (Ctrl+Alt+P or L+R+ZL+ZR): frame time and phases, skipped frames, RAM, GPU lock time; shell feature, no app API

referencePorts.2d-or-software: Chocolate Doom (SDL2 software renderer; console 35 fps cap)
referencePorts.vulkan: Vulkan canary and Vulkan Model on the console (OS 1.4.0 candidate, 60 fps); vkQuake played several minutes on the console (owner run 2026-11-25)
referencePorts.decomp: Red Alert 2 recompilation (Win32/DirectDraw host layer): emulator reached skirmish gameplay in docked and handheld (2026-11-25); console not run
